name: Ewing sarcoma
theme: the fusion-defined bone cancer · every-two-weeks won its trial

meta.title: Ewing sarcoma in silico decision trainer
meta.condition: Ewing sarcoma (bone and extraskeletal), pediatric/AYA and adult
meta.population: Children, adolescents, and young adults with Ewing sarcoma - THE FUSION-DEFINED BONE CANCER: EWSR1-FLI1 (~85%, convention-grade) defines the entity, and the WHO 2020 reclassification (receipts verified) carved the old 'Ewing-like' territory into FOUR separate round-cell entities - Ewing, CIC-rearranged, BCOR-altered, AND EWSR1-non-ETS sarcomas (the fourth border the briefing initially missed) - none of which take this trainer's menu. ~200 US pediatric cases/yr (ACS; more counting AYA), second-commonest pediatric bone cancer, median age ~15, strong European-ancestry predilection. THE SIGNATURE IS TEMPO: interval-compressed VDC/IE every TWO weeks beat every-three-weeks in a randomized trial (AEWS0031 - 5-yr EFS 73% vs 65%, snippet-verified; 10-yr 70% vs 61% in the verified long-term receipt) - the registry's cleanest case of a schedule, not a molecule, winning the trial. And THE COMPRESSION CEILING is taught beside it: every add-on since has failed randomized testing (VTC - AEWS1031 negative, verified; ganitumab - AEWS1221 negative, verified) - intensification beyond compression is the disease's graveyard.
meta.summary: Evidence-linked teaching application for the fusion-defined bone cancer where TEMPO WON THE TRIAL. The verified arc: IESS-I made doxorubicin non-negotiable (5-yr RFS 60% vs 24%, snippet-verified); INT-0091 added ifosfamide/etoposide for LOCALIZED disease only (EFS 69% vs 54%, mirror-verified - and its no-benefit-in-metastatic half is taught just as loudly); AEWS0031 compressed the calendar (every-2-weeks beat every-3 - the G-CSF-enabled schedule victory); and EE2012 unified the Atlantic (VDC/IE beat VIDE on both efficacy AND toxicity - EFS HR 0.70, snippet-verified - 'should now be the standa…
meta.disclaimer: Synthetic teaching environment. Not medical advice; every number is a claim with a citation and an expiry date.
meta.classification: WHO 2020 undifferentiated-small-round-cell-sarcoma family with Ewing as the fusion-confirmed member (EWSR1-FLI1/EWSR1-ERG); borders explicit - osteosarcoma reroutes LIVE (the registry's FIFTEENTH live reroute, to its own trainer); CIC-rearranged/BCOR-altered/EWSR1-non-ETS sarcomas are SEPARATE ENTITIES (verified WHO receipts) and block honestly; staging as localized vs lung-only-metastatic vs bone/marrow-metastatic - the three-chapter census
meta.response: Imaging response conventional; histologic response prognostic at consolidation decisions (EE99-R2Loc population); relapse surveillance lung- and skeleton-focused

refs.label: THE FUSION + THE FOUR BORDERS, verified: WHO 2020 receipts (PMID 33179614, pubmed-url-match: 'The 2020 WHO Classification of Soft Tissue Tumours: news and perspectives' + 41886300, matched: RadioGraphics round-cell update) - the undifferentiated-small-round-cell family holds FOUR entities: Ewing, CIC-rearranged, BCOR-altered, AND EWSR1-non-ETS (the fourth border the briefing initially missed - correction). EWSR1-FLI1 ~85% / EWSR1-ERG ~10% at convention grade (secondary sources; cite a review, not a bare PMID) | PMID 33179614 + abstract read firsthand 2026-08-26
refs.src: WHO/pathology literature (matched; border corrected to four)

refs.label: GENOMICS AS PROGNOSIS, NOT ROUTING, verified: Tirode (Cancer Discov 2014 - PMID 25223734, pubmed-url-match: STAG2 17%, CDKN2A 12%, TP53 7%; STAG2+TP53 co-mutated = 'particularly dismal' - verified snippet) + the COG STAG2 protein-LOSS receipt (36221002, matched - the cleaner clinical read). THE THREE-PAPER TRAP documented: Tirode/Brohl (25010205)/Crompton are near-identical 2014 'genomic landscape' titles - attribute carefully

THE ORIGIN RECEIPT: IESS-I (Nesbit, JCO 1990 - PMID 2213103, pubmed-url-match): 5-yr RFS 60% (VAC+doxorubicin) vs 24% (VAC alone) vs 44% (VAC+bilateral pulmonary RT) - verified snippet; doxorubicin non-negotiable ever since | PMID 2213103 + abstract read firsthand 2026-08-26

THE IE RECEIPT WITH ITS HONEST HALF: INT-0091 (Grier, NEJM 2003;348:694-701 - PMID 12594313 MIRROR-VERIFIED only: exact title matched on nejm.org/PRIME mirrors, the pubmed URL itself never surfaced in three attempts - manual PubMed re-check queued): nonmetastatic 5-yr EFS 69% vs 54%, OS 72% vs 61% (returned-text numbers) - and NO benefit in metastatic disease (the half this trainer teaches just as loudly). THE NUMBER-SWAP hazard documented: EFS 69/54 vs OS 72/61 | PMID 12594313 + abstract read firsthand 2026-08-26

THE COMPRESSION RECEIPT (the signature): AEWS0031 (Womer, JCO 2012;30:4148-54 - PMID 23091096 attested-in-results; the pubmed-url that surfaced with exact title is the LONG-TERM follow-up 37651654, matched): q2-week VDC/IE beat q3-week - 5-yr EFS 73% vs 65% (verified in returned text); 10-yr 70% vs 61%, p=0.03 (long-term receipt). 'Without increased toxicity' consistent-with-abstract, memory-grade phrasing. THE HORIZON TRAP documented (don't mix 5-yr and 10-yr figures) + THE PMID-ASSIGNMENT CONFLICT logged: one sweep attributed 37651654 to AEWS1031 - the anchors sweep's exact-title match assigns it to AEWS0031 long-term; AEWS1031's own receipt is 34652968 | PMID 37651654 + abstract read firsthand 2026-08-26

THE TRANSATLANTIC CONVERGENCE, verified: EE2012 (Brennan, Lancet 2022;400:1513-21; PMID 36522207 attested; companion editorial 36522196 pubmed-url-matched 'Towards a new era in the treatment of Ewing sarcoma'): VDC/IE beat VIDE - EFS HR 0.70 (0.51-0.95), OS HR 0.64 (0.42-0.96), 98% posterior probability; 3-yr EFS 67% vs 61%; less toxic AND shorter - 'should now be the standard of care' (verified snippets). THE GROUP-FLIP TRAP documented: group 1 = VIDE (61%), group 2 = VDC/IE (67%). The zoledronic-acid randomization published BJC 2026 - direction UNVERIFIED, not cited for a result | PMID 36522196 + abstract read firsthand 2026-08-26

THE BUMEL SPLIT AT EXACT GRADE - and the trial-name trap CORRECTED: the BuMel randomization in high-risk LOCALIZED disease is EE99-R2/R2Loc (Whelan, JCO 2018 - PMID 30188789, pubmed-url-match: 3-yr EFS 66.9% vs 53.1%, HR 0.63; OS 77.8% vs 69.9% - verified) - NOT 'R1' (EE99-R1 = cyclophosphamide-vs-ifosfamide noninferiority, PMID 24982464, matched - the briefing's label corrected). R2Pulm (Dirksen, JCO 2019): BuMel NOT superior to WLI in lung-metastatic disease (3-yr EFS 56.6% vs 50.6%, HR 0.79 [0.56-1.10], P=.16 - verified in returned text). US non-adoption of BuMel: memory-grade, directionally supported (COG standard stayed compressed VDC/IE without HDT) | PMID 30188789 + abstract read firsthand 2026-08-26

THE LUNG-ONLY CHAPTER, verified: EICESS 114-patient lung-metastatic receipt (PMID 9738574, pubmed-url-match: 5-yr EFS 38% with WLI vs 27% without; pulmonary relapse ~halved) + the WLI dose/toxicity receipt (18398583, matched: 12-21 Gy) - DIRECTION verified; the p-VALUES CONFLICT across secondary sources (0.002 vs .09 - said, and dropped from cards). Lung-only >> bone/marrow outcome split: standard, memory-grade for the explicit comparison | PMID 9738574 + abstract read firsthand 2026-08-26

RADIOSENSITIVITY + LOCAL CONTROL: Ewing is radiosensitive (the standing osteosarcoma contrast - supported across reviews and POG 8346 dose-response data; no single pubmed-url snippet, memory-grade citation-wise, uncontradicted); surgery preferred where resectable without major morbidity, definitive RT for axial/unresectable, combined for margins (conventions + EICESS local-therapy receipt PMID 29610659, pubmed-url-match). THE DECOY documented: a 1936 Radiology paper literally titled 'Radioresistant Ewing Sarcomas of Bone' - never let it surface as a counter-receipt | PMID 29610659 + abstract read firsthand 2026-08-26
refs.src: EICESS + RT literature (matched receipt + convention; decoy documented)

refs.label: THE BENCHMARK WITH HELD NUMBERS - rEECur (ISRCTN36453794), the FIRST randomized trial in relapsed Ewing: high-dose ifosfamide beat topotecan-cyclophosphamide (phase III - ABSTRACT-GRADE: ASCO 2022 LBA2; NO indexed full publication found; median-OS figures CONFLICT across outlets - ASCO Post 15.4-vs-10.5 vs OncLive 16.8-vs-10.4 - NOT CARDED). ARM HISTORY CORRECTED: gemcitabine-docetaxel dropped at first interim, irinotecan-temozolomide at second ('beat IT' = interim-dropping evidence, not head-to-head); carboplatin-etoposide ADDED late (ASCO 2025 assessment - direction unverified); TRABECTEDIN = the 2026 arm. NOT A US DOOR (UK/EU/Australia/NZ - loud)
refs.src: ASCO abstracts + consortium announcements (abstract-grade; corrections logged)

refs.label: THE US TRABECTEDIN RECEIPT: SARC037 (NCT04067115, completed 2025-12): trabectedin 1-hr + low-dose irinotecan in relapsed/refractory Ewing - ORR 28% (5/18), mDOR 7.5 mo, 6-mo PFS 40% (secondhand press/ASCO-abstract figures; display-grade) - the result that seeded rEECur's trabectedin arm; full publication = watch item

THE GRAVEYARD, verified - and one exit corrected: IGF-1R DEAD (AEWS1221 ganitumab - PMID 36669140, pubmed-url-match: no EFS benefit, added pneumonitis incl. one death; R1507 - 22025149, matched: ~10% rare-dramatic-unsustained; figitumumab memory-grade); VTC add-on NEGATIVE (AEWS1031 - 34652968, matched); TK216 'limited activity' (JCO 2024; sponsor Oncternal folded - doors dead); PARP monotherapy 0/12 olaparib (futility); checkpoint monotherapy 0/13 Ewing in SARC028 (28988646 lineage). CORRECTED OUT: REGOBONE's Ewing cohort was POSITIVE (8-wk PFS 56% vs 7.7% vs placebo, BJC 2023) - regorafenib is IN the frontline randomization, not the graveyard; CABONE cabozantinib positive-signal confirmed. THE R1507 TWO-PAPER TRAP documented (JCO 2011 Ewing 22025149 vs Cancer 2014 non-Ewing 24797726) | PMID 36669140 + abstract read firsthand 2026-08-26

EPI at ACS grade: ~200 US children/teens per year (more counting AYA), incidence ~2.9 per million, second-commonest pediatric bone cancer, median age ~15, marked European-ancestry predilection (ACS + StatPearls NBK559183 - no single PMID pinned; cite the secondary sources). Adult Ewing runs worse in series (convention-grade)

AEWS2431 (NCT06820957, COG/NCTN) - THE ONLY OPEN RANDOMIZED FRONTLINE DOOR, and METASTATIC-ONLY: VDC/IE x10 then randomization to vincristine-irinotecan-regorafenib consolidation vs continued compressed VDC/IE (+ RT dose-escalation component, 64.8 Gy for >=200mL) - built on REGOBONE's positive Ewing cohort. OPENED (actual start 2025-11-10) - current recruiting state HEDGED per refresh 2026-08-20 (conflicting aggregator states; firsthand CT.gov read pending). THE CORRECTION: the briefing's 'AEWS2032' DOES NOT EXIST. And the desert said: NO open randomized door for newly diagnosed LOCALIZED Ewing anywhere

Lurbinectedin pediatric/AYA relapsed Ewing (NCT05734066, Jazz, phase 1/2) - RECRUITING (web-verified 2026-08-20, registry re-check due); basis: adult basket ORR 14.3%/mDOR 4.2mo (35486638 lineage, secondhand); the lurbi+irinotecan Ewing trial NCT05042934 WITHDRAWN 2022; no Ewing FDA designation (the 2025 approval action was SCLC-only - off-label availability is access, not evidence); the most plausible future registrational vehicle

THE CELL LAYER told exactly: St. Jude B7-H3 CAR-T + hypofractionated RT (NCT07222735, phase 1, opened 2026-01-21 - RECRUITING, web-verified 2026-08-20; the 3CAR program explicitly takes Ewing) + Seattle B7-H3 (NCT04483778 - 2026 status UNVERIFIED). THE DECOY CORRECTED: STEAP1 CAR-T for Ewing is PRECLINICAL (IL-18-armored, bioRxiv 2025-12) - the Fred Hutch clinical STEAP1 trial is PROSTATE cancer (NCT06236139). GD2 in Ewing: heterogeneous expression; CESS-GD2 (NCT06839703) screens for it and is EX-US + not-yet-recruiting

THE SHELF: liposomal irinotecan weekly (NCT06340204 - UNVERIFIED beyond listing); TP-1287 oral CDK9 (Ewing orphan designation; 2026 trial status UNVERIFIED); REGO-INTER-EWI (NCT05830084 - UNVERIFIED, presumed EU); rEECur trabectedin arm (ex-US - watch for any US/COG participation flip); SARC037 full publication watch; stranded designations (ONCT-216 RPDD/ODD/FT - asset-transfer watch); Vigil ph3 TERMINATED; seclidemstat Ewing arm CLOSED (the 2024 partial-hold history; the 2025 hold-lift applies to the MDS trial, NOT Ewing); NO Ewing BLA/NDA/PDUFA 2024-2026 (verified absence); ~5 NCTs flagged unverified total

El-Jawahri A, LeBlanc T, VanDusen H, et al. Effect of Inpatient Palliative Care on Quality of Life 2 Weeks After Hematopoietic Stem Cell Transplantation: A Randomized Clinical Trial. JAMA 2016;316(20):2094-2103 (PMID 27893130, NCT02207322) — abstract read firsthand 2026-09-10. POPULATION CAUTION, added at that read because the previous label named no population at all: this is a SINGLE-INSTITUTION randomized trial of 160 adults with HAEMATOLOGICAL malignancy hospitalized for autologous or allogeneic stem-cell transplantation, and its outcomes are quality of life, depression, anxiety, fatigue and symptom burden — it reports no survival and no adverse-event table. It is the factory's standing anchor for the PRINCIPLE that palliative care runs alongside active treatment rather than after it; it is not evidence in this tumour type and is not the source of any number on this card.
